articles.title: TheZebra.com Welcomes Former Google Product Leader Daniel Herrington as Chief AI Officer
articles.mainIdea: TheZebra.com Welcomes Former Google Product Leader Daniel Herrington as Chief AI Officer
articles.summary: Business Wire: TheZebra.com Welcomes Former Google Product Leader Daniel Herrington as Chief AI Officer. AUSTIN, Texas, February 18, 2026--TheZebra.com, the easiest way to compare and buy insurance, today announced the appointment of Daniel Herrington as Chief AI Officer. Herrington brings more than a decade of experience in AI product development to the leading insurtech company, having served in multiple senior roles at Google, Vroom, Capital One and Priceline. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, VRM.
